data.name: Jamanaa
data.gender_notes: Jamanaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'jamana', meaning a 'gift', 'reward', or 'bounty'. It is often associated with the idea of being bestowed with blessings and favors, and is a reminder of Allah's generosity towards His creation. The name Jamanaa carries the meaning “Gift, Reward, Bounty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Jamanaa usually hope their child will grow to embody gift, reward, bounty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the blessings and mercy of Allah, and the idea of being grateful for the gifts and blessings that come our way.
data.etymology: Jamanaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift, Reward, Bounty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jamanaa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: جمانة
in_arabic.meaning: جمانة تعني الؤلؤة أو الحبة البيضاء الجميلة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جمانة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني الؤلؤة أو الحبة البيضاء الجميلة. وقد ورد ذكر الؤلؤ في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، مما يضيف للاسم قيمة روحية ودينية. يستخدم الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لما له من دلالة على الجمال والرقة.

in_urdu.name: جمانہ
in_urdu.meaning: جمانہ کا مطلب ہے موتی یا سفید خوبصورت ٹکڑی
in_urdu.long_meaning: جمانہ ایک عربی मूल کا مؤنث علم کا نام ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے موتی یا سفید خوبصورت ٹکڑی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ موتی کو خوبصورتی اور دولت کی علامت مانا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: जमाना
in_hindi.meaning: जमाना का अर्थ है मोती या सुंदर सफेद टुकड़ी
in_hindi.long_meaning: जमाना एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है मोती या सुंदर सफेद टुकड़ी। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रचलित है, जहां मोती को सौंदर्य और समृद्धि का प्रतीक माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جمانه
in_pashto.meaning: جمانه دى موتی یا سپینه ښکلې ټوټې معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: جمانه د عربي اصل يو ښځينه نوم دی، چې د موتی یا سپینه ښکلې ټوټې معنی ورکوي. په افغان او پښتون کلتور کې، موتی د ښکلا او شتمنۍ نښه ده، نو دا نوم ډیر مقبول دی.

in_english.name: Jamanaa
in_english.meaning: Jamanaa means pearl or beautiful white bead
in_english.long_meaning: Jamanaa is a feminine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'pearl' or 'beautiful white bead'. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'j-m-n', which conveys the idea of gathering or collecting precious things. In Islamic tradition, pearls are considered symbols of purity, beauty, and spirituality. The name Jamanaa is popular across various Muslim cultures, reflecting the universal appeal of its meaning and significance.
